analyst_view.overall: Iñigo Pérez's Villarreal (9th) have lost their last two home games, 0-1 to Espanyol and 0-6 to PSG in the Champions League. José Bordalás's Getafe (13th) beat Sevilla 3-1 but lost 0-1 at Brighton in the Conference League on Thursday, so they have had a day less rest. Villarreal are without Alassane Diatta, with Gerard Moreno, Foyth and Akhomach doubts; Getafe get Carvajal and Enes Ünal back but are missing Uche, with Juanmi a doubt.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.2 goals. Getafe have scored only eight league goals, joint-fewest in the division, and Bordalás's side is built to break games up. A Villarreal team short of confidence and possibly without Gerard Moreno may struggle to open them up, so a low-scoring game is most likely.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.6 corners. Villarreal should have plenty of the ball against a deep block, which brings corners, but Getafe's direct style produces few at the other end. Nothing in the news moves us from the site.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.6 cards. Getafe under Bordalás are among the most fouling sides in Spain and they play three days after a European away game, while a frustrated home side adds to that. We lean slightly higher.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.8 shots. Getafe's games are broken up by fouls and stoppages and they rarely commit numbers forward, so the total looks more likely to come in a little below the site.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.9 shots on target. Getafe are hard to get clean shots against when they sit deep, and their own attack relies on few, direct chances, so we lean lower.
